columns.name: survey_round
columns.label: Survey round
columns.description: Year of the ECV round.

columns.name: record_id
columns.label: Record ID
columns.description: Child record, unique within the round.

columns.name: household_id
columns.label: Household ID
columns.description: Household of the child.

columns.name: caregiver_id
columns.label: Caregiver ID
columns.description: Mother or caregiver interviewed.

columns.name: province
columns.label: Province
columns.description: Province name, as recorded by the survey.

columns.name: province_id
columns.label: Province ID
columns.description: SNIS DHIS2 ID of the province.

columns.name: health_zone
columns.label: Health zone
columns.description: Health zone name, as recorded. Names repeat across provinces: use `health_zone_id`.

columns.name: health_zone_id
columns.label: Health zone ID
columns.description: SNIS DHIS2 ID of the health zone.

columns.name: health_area
columns.label: Health area
columns.description: Sampled health area (cluster).

columns.name: residence_area
columns.label: Residence area
columns.description: urban or rural.

columns.name: sampling_weight
columns.label: Sampling weight
columns.description: Weight of the child for estimates.

columns.name: child_age_months
columns.label: Age (months)
columns.description: Age of the child in completed months.

columns.name: child_sex
columns.label: Sex
columns.description: female or male.

columns.name: has_bednet
columns.label: Household has a bednet
columns.description: Household answer, repeated on each child of the household.

columns.name: has_card
columns.label: Vaccination card seen
columns.description: Whether the interviewer saw the card.

columns.name: received_penta1
columns.label: Received Penta1
columns.description: Card or recall; null when unknown.

columns.name: received_penta2
columns.label: Received Penta2
columns.description: Card or recall; null when unknown.

columns.name: received_penta3
columns.label: Received Penta3
columns.description: Card or recall; null when unknown.

columns.name: received_mcv1
columns.label: Received MCV1
columns.description: Card or recall; null when unknown. Due at 9 months.

columns.name: received_mcv2
columns.label: Received MCV2
columns.description: Card or recall; null when unknown. Due at 15 months.

columns.name: zero_dose
columns.label: Zero-dose
columns.description: True if the child has not received Penta1; null when Penta1 is unknown. See README.md before computing a zero-dose rate.
